pin.scope: GEM VDI development: FX 1.26 at D600, private 512 KiB VRAM, inactive at cold boot. Detection only is tested by G0.

peripherals.name: happy-none
peripherals.firmware: built-in high-level model; quiet command only

observer.mode: same binary, EXEC816_LATENCY_TRACE and EXEC816_MASK_TRACE environment gates; replay with both unset

keyboard_input.mode: POKEY matrix scan; PushRawKey/ReleaseRawKey immediate=false; modifier matrix transitions
keyboard_input.initialization: KEY ALL up enables scan mode before modifier changes

mouse_input.mapping: unmodified built-in preset; all other input maps disabled in isolated test profile
mouse_input.host_path: ATInputManager::OnMouseMove(0, dx, dy); OnButtonChanged(0, MouseLMB, state)
mouse_input.sensitivity: default preset: 16 integer host units per electrical transition; no mapping acceleration
mouse_input.capture: headless scheduled relative motion; GUI uses normal host mouse capture
mouse_input.observer: EXEC816_MOUSE_TRACE=1 logs MOUSE_HOST and passive MOUSE_PHASE in base scheduler cycles; unset for replay
mouse_input.controller_timing: Unmodified slow (scanline) scheduler: each phase delay clamps 0x1000000/remaining fixed-point distance to 1..256 scanlines. The passive observer timestamps output on the base CPU scheduler.

scope: Raw and optimized: 13 complete scene comparisons each, separate application Task, physical click/key updates, obscured shell output, app-first cooperative close and shell-first retirement with continued app input.

Late-key A/B uses one frozen raw image and identical bootstrap writes/stimuli: original pending mask chains the owned key into ROM and restarts the native entry; corrected mask returns to native capture and completes. Production additionally checks live keyboard ownership.
Standalone keyboard/BREAK raw and optimized tests cover native capture without an ST sampler, acquisition/route retirement, hardware restoration, guards and ownership.
Successful DT5 paths were compiled with the upcoming DT6 partial-admission unwind as well; that path is not exercised here. DT6 records the failure fixture separately.

Loaded two-client timing and the final packaged shell pipeline occupancy are recorded by DT6/DT7; DT1 recording-backend capacity, invalid batch and slow-consumer checks and DT4 gesture/loss checks remain separate evidence.

Bank-zero growth is zero; the application occupies an existing 1024-byte stack/256-byte DP pool (1312 reserved bytes including guards). Development tests do not establish physical-device or whole-system qualification.
